steps.title: Design the arcade and game rules
Connect the camera and hand controls
Build, play-test and check the result

probes: Run bundled app, grant camera, track both hands and pinch a game card; check tracking loss and stop releases camera.
params.question: Can the real webcam and two-hand tracking be validated on this host? Implementation will use local MediaPipe; hardware results remain unverified until an actual permission and camera session succeeds.

todos.content: Design the arcade and game rules
Connect the camera and hand controls
Build, play-test and check the result

probes: Run npm install with package registry access, download model and WASM assets, then npm run build and cargo build.
params.question: Can dependencies and the MediaPipe model be installed? Host DNS is unavailable, offline npm cache lacks @mediapipe/tasks-vision, and Craft Anything build_command_run was rejected by automatic approval policy. The requested stack is retained; builds remain unverified until dependency installation is possible.

error: The running build took the check, but it hadn't finished after 1 minutes.

params.text: Fixed missing-icon compiler panic by adding app/icons/icon.png (256×256 RGBA) and explicitly listing it in app/tauri.conf.json. Added macOS --screenshot output via WKWebView native snapshot and --self-test JSON output; the frontend test navigates through practice mode, measures live Pong paddle motion and Bubble Pop scoring, and checks visible HUD against live engine state. Existing five unit tests pass; npm build and cargo build --offline pass. Final rebuild_check: build passed, screenshot passed (2880×1880), gameplay self-test passed (paddle 310→160, 18 bubbles popped, HUD score matches). Added app/mechanics.json with 31 implementation-sourced values; sheet passes parsing but runtime comparisons remain unverified and checker explicitly says another builder turn cannot resolve this. No original visual target exists (capture/README.md says build from request alone). MediaPipe public model/vendor/wasm folders are still empty, and real webcam/two-hand tracking is unverified. Existing dependency unknown remains partially open due tracking assets even though native and frontend builds are now verified. No further builder-resolvable check failures remain.

Continued in app/: fixed Vision.start cancellation during async runtime/files/model startup. Cancelled starts no longer launch CPU fallback or overwrite delegate diagnostics; late models are closed; inference timing/quality reset on restart and delegate clears on stop. Added 3 regression tests (8 total passing). npm run build, cargo build --offline, and rebuild_check all succeed. Latest rebuild_check: screenshot 2880x1880 and pointer gameplay/HUD passed (18 bubbles, 530 points); mechanics sheet readable but runtime comparisons remain unverified. Attempted npm install --include=optional and setup:tracking; MediaPipe package absent from cache and DNS cannot resolve registry.npmjs.org, so runtime/model still absent. Real webcam and two-hand tracking remain unverified. No original reference exists per capture/README.md. Next useful work requires tracking asset availability and real camera permission/hardware validation; don't claim hand tracking has been tested.

Changed app/ to use native Apple Vision hand tracking on macOS without MediaPipe downloads. Added Objective-C Vision bridge src/hand_tracking.m built and linked by build.rs, Tauri commands native_tracking_available/track_hands (blocking inference off UI thread), native-tracking.ts JPEG canvas adapter, async Vision.tick with generation guards. Non-macOS retains local MediaPipe. npm run build, cargo build --offline and all 10 Vitest tests pass. rebuild_check passed build, app screenshot (2880x1880), and pointer gameplay (18 bubbles/640 score); mechanics runtime comparisons remain unverified. Native standalone smoke probe under restricted exec failed CVPixelBuffer creation, so real camera/native inference remains unverified; do not claim tested hardware or successful live hand detection. No downloaded assets installed because sandbox network is disabled. Existing earlier MediaPipe unknowns are historical; macOS no longer depends on them. User should reopen rebuilt app to use native tracking.

MediaPipe repair in app/: @mediapipe/tasks-vision 0.10.32 now required/exact in package and lock; installed SDK already present. Copied matching JS bundle and SIMD/non-SIMD WASM to public/. Removed Apple Vision bypass from Vision.start; real MediaPipe local FilesetResolver + model path, VIDEO, two hands, GPU initialization with CPU fallback. Added monotonic timestamp guard and per-detection pinch consumption in TrackingLayer to prevent held press activating another target. Strict setup script validates SDK/runtime parity and model archive; mandatory postinstall and prebuild fail explicitly if assets missing. BLOCKED: official hand_landmarker.task absent; direct fetch ENOTFOUND storage.googleapis.com. Craft Anything build_command_run exact command npm run setup:tracking denied with approval policy never. Historical 04:07:10 rejection has no recorded arguments; do not invent its exact command. Online npm install cancelled; offline lockfile refresh succeeded. 12 Vitest tests pass; tsc and Vite compile pass. npm run build intentionally FAILS readiness guard due missing official model. rebuild_check native build, screenshot/launch and pointer game self-test passed (18 bubbles/610 score), but it bypasses npm prebuild, proves no live hand inference, and mechanics comparisons remain unverified. app/TRACKING-VALIDATION.txt records blockers, recovery commands, automated/manual distinction and physical camera acceptance checklist. UI/CSS unchanged. Do not call complete or claim physical webcam validation; next requires network/approval-enabled environment to run npm install, npm run setup:tracking, npm run build and real hands testing.

Current repair in app/: model public/models/hand_landmarker.task was ALREADY present at turn start (7,819,105 bytes), unzip -t passes with hand_detector.tflite and hand_landmarks_detector.tflite. SHA256 fbc2a30080c3c557093b5ddfc334698132eb341044ccee322ccf8bcf3607cde1. Found setup-tracking.mjs rejected valid official task because ZIP header starts at offset 2, after 0000 prefix. Changed validation to full pinned SHA256. npm run build including prebuild now PASSES; npm test 12/12 PASS. All six runtime/model assets byte-identical in public/ and dist/. Existing model URL local document.baseURI, VIDEO/two-hands/GPU with CPU fallback correct; no camera integration/UI changes this turn. rebuild_check native build, launch/screenshot and pointer gameplay pass; mechanics remain unverified. HTTP GET and live model initialization are UNVERIFIED: shell cannot connect loopback or resolve Google host; web_site_open model URL rejected 'MCP tool call requires approval, but approval policy is never'. Do not claim 404 resolved or real tracking initialized. No fake webcam/inference used. TRACKING-VALIDATION.txt replaced outdated missing-model claims with current evidence and remaining acceptance checks. Full release Tauri build in progress via exec session 23492, CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true npm run tauri build; beforeBuildCommand passes, compiling native release now.

Repair complete only for build/assets; live tracking remains UNVERIFIED. In app/scripts/setup-tracking.mjs changed invalid ZIP-at-offset-zero validator to full model SHA256 fbc2a30080c3c557093b5ddfc334698132eb341044ccee322ccf8bcf3607cde1. The supplied public/models/hand_landmarker.task was already present (7,819,105 bytes), valid ZIP with 0000 prefix then PK and both TFLite models. npm run build and 12 Vitest tests PASS. All six model/JS/SIMD/non-SIMD WASM assets byte-identical public vs dist. CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true npm run tauri build PASS, release bundle app/target/release/bundle/macos/HANDVERSE.app built. Existing objc macro cfg warnings nonfatal. rebuild_check build/launch/pointer game PASS, mechanics comparisons unverified. No UI/camera changes. Existing local document.baseURI model path, VIDEO, two hands, GPU/CPU fallback correct. Fresh download blocked DNS; shell loopback unavailable; web_site_open HTTP model URL rejected by automatic approval policy (never). Cannot assert HTTP 200 or real HandLandmarker webcam initialization. No fake video/results used. app/TRACKING-VALIDATION.txt has current evidence and remaining live acceptance checks. Final must state limitation, not success.

Global tracking repair implemented in app/. New GlobalHandTrackingProvider above App navigation owns persistent attached inference video, stream/model lifecycle and one TrackingLayer. Camera previews create separate video elements sharing stream, detach preview only; no route camera shutdown. App diagnostics/calibration, GameView all five games and cursor consume context/shared service. Vision supports independent subscribers, idempotent current-session startup, hidden-document inference suspension, generation checks after gesture callbacks preventing stale loop scheduling, retains gesture machines over hand loss. Global navigation PinchGate requires open then pinch, holds latch over navigation/occlusion, one native click with viewport hit test and disabled/hidden/inert rejection; one fixed overlay with trail/click feedback. Existing design/styles/game engine unchanged. npm test 18 tests PASS; production web build PASS; offline npm run tauri build PASS (existing objc cfg warnings only); final rebuild_check PASS build, 2880x1880 screenshot/launch, pointer game self-test. Runtime mechanics reference comparisons and physical webcam/real-hand acceptance remain UNVERIFIED. No fake tracking substituted; pointer practice self-test is not webcam evidence. Full requested real-hand route sequence remains manual, documented appended app/TRACKING-VALIDATION.txt. Existing unknown about missing dependencies/build is stale: local assets verified and builds succeeded. Final response must be 1–3 plain sentences and disclose real-hand testing unverified.

Production MediaPipe repair completed in app/. Root cause CONFIRMED in actual packaged WKWebView: FilesetResolver appends slash, old wasm/ base produced /wasm//vision_wasm_internal.js; Tauri macOS embedded asset lookup missed and SPA fallback returned 200 text/html (443 bytes), so classic script could not set self.ModuleFactory. Correct base runtimeURL('wasm'); runtime preflight validates statuses/MIME/signatures, GPU->CPU and matching non-SIMD GPU->CPU fallback logs, serialized startup factory access/cancellation, script/CSP logs and Camera Setup error details. src/main.rs builds same configured window via from_config with resource callback; tauri.conf.json windows[0].create=false prevents auto duplicate. Runtime allowlist supplies JS/WASM/model MIME and nosniff, missing paths 404. Existing narrow CSP unchanged. Added --runtime-test JSON mode, --audit-runtime-assets extraction and packaged runtime self-test invoked by normal --self-test. Final npm run build and CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true npx tauri build --bundles app PASS, npm test 21 PASS. Final rebuild_check PASS build, 2880x1880 app launch/screenshot, pointer gameplay; checks/round-0/self-test.json runtime.passed=true: tauri://localhost, both SIMD/GPU and non-SIMD/GPU initialized + real blank-canvas inference, correct MIME types, malformed path 404, no script/CSP errors. All six runtime/model assets extracted from final .app executable byte match verified public/ assets at MediaPipe 0.10.32; model pinned SHA correct. Actual model response originally text/html despite correct bytes, now application/octet-stream. Direct native_window_capture tool rejected automatic approval because approval policy never; separately authorized rebuild_check ran actual app successfully. Physical camera permissions, real-hand tracking/cursor/pinch menus/Bubble Pop and offline post-install route sequence remain UNVERIFIED; reference mechanics measurements also unverified. CPU fallback tested with mocks, successful packaged GPU did not need CPU. No UI redesign, provider architecture, game rules, records/settings/calibration/cursor behavior changes. Detailed root cause, files, evidence, exact manual tests and diagnostic commands appended app/TRACKING-VALIDATION.txt. Final response user requires 1-3 plain sentences; distinguish verified packaged runtime from unverified physical hands.

Prepared GitHub desktop releases entirely in app/ (intended repo root), no UI/game/gesture changes. Root Cargo.toml/tauri.conf.json is actual crate, src-tauri unused template excluded by new .gitignore. Added .github/workflows/release.yml using official tauri-action@v0; native macos-15 ARM64, macos-15-intel x64 (macos14 retired), windows-latest x64 NSIS+MSI. Tag version guard; draft release, publish only after whole matrix + embedded byte audits; npm ci/checks, optional Apple notarization and Windows PFX signing, logs/installers artifacts. Root window useHttpsScheme=true for Windows secure local origin, added https ipc CSP, platform bundle overrides, generated native desktop icons from existing icon. build.rs clang follows target arch. Platform Objective-C cfg already correct; Windows retains local MediaPipe pipeline. Added README, docs release/notes/testing/third-party/validation and notices in public. No app license chosen; async owner question sent, no license file. Validation: npm ci offline dry-run lock compatibility PASS, npm check:ci frontend + 21 tests + mac cargo check --locked PASS. Release HANDVERSE.app builds. DMG attempt FAIL environment hdiutil create Device not configured (no workaround/disabling protections). rebuild_check PASS build, app screenshot 2880x1880, pointer gameplay; checks/round-0/self-test.json actual SIMD GPU + non-SIMD GPU init/inference PASS. Embedded six assets extracted byte match all public originals. Runtime physical camera, hand cursor/pinch with real hands, all games/offline acceptance, Windows/Intel compile/runtime remain UNVERIFIED; mechanics reference behavior unverified. No .git supplied. git ls-remote exact https://github.com/h-yusuf/handverse-ai.git fails DNS; gh auth status reports token invalid with network unavailable. No commit/push/tag/remote workflow run performed, deliberately preserve upstream history; instructions clone exact repo, apply app contents at root, merge branch then tag. docs/VALIDATION.md records all outcomes. User final must be 1-3 plain sentences, mentioning changes, passed local checks and limits/publishing blocked.

Continuation completed: npm run check:ci passed again (version/assets, TypeScript/Vite frontend, 21/21 tests, cargo check --locked). npm run tauri build -- --bundles app exited 0 and regenerated app/target/release/bundle/macos/HANDVERSE.app (21.51 MiB). No source fixes necessary; nine existing objc macro cargo-clippy cfg warnings remain nonfatal. Added rerun results to app/docs/VALIDATION.md. Prior release preparation preserved: app/ is intended repo root with root Cargo/Tauri, GitHub release workflow for macOS ARM64/Intel + Windows x64, optional signing, embedded assets audits, docs. No Git history here, prior GitHub DNS/auth unavailable; no publish performed. DMG previously blocked by hdiutil Device not configured; not retried this turn. Physical camera/real hands, full games/offline acceptance, Windows/Intel runtime remain unverified. No license chosen. Latest user asks build/fix as needed, final 1-3 plain sentences.

User asked Indonesian 'apakah sudah di push?' Confirmed neither workspace nor app/ has .git; git -C app status reports not a git repository. No push performed; remote state not verified. Updated app/docs/VALIDATION.md with push status and fresh results. npm run tauri build -- --bundles app exited 0, rebuilt 21.51 MiB HANDVERSE.app with nine existing nonfatal objc macro warnings. rebuild_check passed build, launch/screenshot 2880x1880 and pointer gameplay/HUD; reference mechanics comparisons and physical-camera/two-hand tests remain unverified. Existing publication instructions app/docs/RELEASING.md preserve upstream history. No source changes needed for status question.
